description: The license record of every published file that has no comment syntax for the NVIDIA Apache-2.0 header. `python3 tools/license_headers.py check` requires an entry for each such file and validates every entry; tools/license_headers.py documents the classes and fields. An entry with a sha256 pins those bytes: captured data was approved for publication as those bytes, so a change to it needs a new approval and a new entry.
